purpose: Teach: 倉敷/ストライク/ワルツ/アイアン/鉄筋/蝋/シンデレラ/タンゴ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんと倉敷に行ってみたいわね
lines.en: Sho, wouldn't you like to go to Kurashiki with me sometime?
lines.style: Warm, unhurried invitation. Gentle lilt on his name. Eyes soft. The tone of someone offering a door, not pushing through it. Slight pause before 'wouldn't you like,' as if imagining it alongside him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、野球でストライク三振しちゃった
lines.en: Mei-sis, I struck out in baseball.
lines.style: Small, quiet admission. Matter-of-fact surface, but the words come a beat slower than usual. Eyes down, then a quick glance up to see if it matters. The vulnerability of a child trusting an adult with something that stung.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さん、ワルツのリズムが好きなのよ
lines.en: Sho, I've always loved the rhythm of a waltz.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost to herself but speaking to him. Gentle rhythm in the phrasing. Eyes distant, remembering. The kind of confession you make to someone you trust to just listen, not fix.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんからアイアンクラブの使い方教わったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad taught me how to use an iron club.
lines.style: Brightening lift. Proud small chest. The words come faster now—excitement cuts through the earlier sadness. Eyes wider, seeking her recognition of this small competence. A child who learned something real from someone he loves.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、新しい家は鉄筋造りで頑丈なのよ
lines.en: Sho, our new house is built with reinforced concrete—it's really solid.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, but with an undercurrent of comfort. A practical statement delivered with care, as if reassuring him about stability. Voice steady and grounded. The gentleness of offering security without making it obvious.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、蝋燭の灯りを眺めるの好きだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I love watching the candlelight flicker.
lines.style: Soft, absorbed tone. Words drift like the light itself. Eyes dreamy, far away but safe. The voice of a child lost in quiet beauty, trusting her to understand without explanation. Gentle trailing off at the end.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんもシンデレラのお話が大好きなのよ
lines.en: Sho, I love Cinderella's story too.
lines.style: Delighted recognition. A warm brightness. The pleasure of finding the same magic in the same place. Words unhurried, savoring each phrase. A bridge between them—her sharing something precious because he showed her he had the same treasure.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとお母さんがタンゴを踊ってたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and Mom were dancing tango together!
lines.style: Eager rush of words. Eyes bright, bursting to tell her. The breathless energy of a child who saw something beautiful and wants her to see it too. Quick warm excitement, leaning in. The end lands with joy, not trailing off.
